_readme: Results of a commercial program, calculated by Onur Koc (screenshots and project local, not in the repo).
The commercial program prints rounded values (m_Rd with one decimal, numerical integration).
Units kN/m, kNm/m, m, per mille; sign of the commercial program: compression negative.
commercial_type2: concrete diagram type 2 of the commercial program (parabola up to 2 per mille, then constant up to
3.5 per mille) = the model of the app. Used for part A (M-N core), tolerance 0.5 % relative.
commercial_sc: commercial type 4 (SC, SIA 262 Gl. 27) - model difference, no test of the core.
Its shear values (eps_v, k_d, d, v_Rd) are the inputs of parts B and C (building blocks).
Further differences of the commercial program from the app (SIA 262:2025), see NOTES.md section 7:
k_g without the lower limit 1.2 (SIA 262:2013), eta_fc = (30/f_ck)^(1/3), d != h - c in the
shear check, m_Rd in the shear check with a proportionally increased N.
